label: Evaluating generated or specialised output with a golden set and two judges
summary: A golden set of checkable items, stand-ins for two generator versions with controlled failure rates, a strict and a fuzzy judge, their agreement, and bootstrap intervals on the difference; replace the stand-in with your model.
traps: A strict judge that rejects valid formats
Two judges that disagree on borderline outputs
A golden set too small to tell versions apart
A forbidden claim that must never pass

slots.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain
